hypotheses.justification: The other variable hypotheses already imply T2Space G by instance inference. (1) `TotallyDisconnectedSpace.t1Space` (Mathlib/Topology/Separation/Connected.lean:22) gives `T1Space G` from `[TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]`. (2) `T1Space.t0Space` gives `T0Space G`. (3) `IsTopologicalGroup.regularSpace` (Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Group/Pointwise.lean:385) gives `RegularSpace G` from `[IsTopologicalGroup G]`. (4) `instT3Space` (T0 + Regular) gives `T3Space G`. (5) `T3Space.t25Space` and `T25Space.t2Space` give `T2Space G`. That Pointwise file is public-imported through `Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Group.Quotient`, which `ContinuousSection` public-imports, so the instances are visible in this file. The statement `∃ s : C(G ⧸ H, G), ∀ q, QuotientGroup.mk (s q) = q` only needs `TopologicalSpace G`, not T2. The proof calls `quotientMapOfLE_exists_continuous_section_of_isClosed`, which requires `[T2Space G]`, and instance search will supply it from the derivation above. So the binder can be deleted (for example with `omit [T2Space G] in`) and the proof stays unchanged. The `[IsClosed ...]` instance and the other hypotheses (`CompactSpace`, `TotallyDisconnectedSpace`, `IsTopologicalGroup`) are not affected.
